raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "tell"
  role subject "Olga"
  role object "Nadia"
  role topic "her passport had expired"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "her"
  role object "Nadia"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "have an expired passport"
  role subject "Nadia"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "have to go to the consulate"
    role subject ?who
    polarity affirmed
  end
